invariants.rationale: records is dereferenced for isEmpty and sort operations.
outputPartitions likely indicates number of target partitions; negative or zero is probably invalid.
size() of a list is always non-negative.
records.get(0) is accessed after isEmpty() check, safe only if not empty.
getFileGroupPrefix is called on records.get(0) iff records is not empty; otherwise, would pass null if ever called.
